# toml test suite

## Source

The TOML test suite, toml-test (github.com/toml-lang/toml-test, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2018 TOML authors), as published in the crate `toml-test-data`: the `.toml` files of `tests/valid` and `tests/invalid` that its `files-toml-1.1.0` lists. Every file it lists is here; `NOTICE` says so.

## Version

`toml-test-data` 2.14.1, TOML 1.1.
